title: CAPTF contract v1alpha1: machine role outputs
description: The machine role's root outputs as decoded from state, after the controller's normalization ("" for an ID becomes null) (common.md, machine.md). Every contract output must be declared; null means "not yet known". Extra, non-contract outputs are allowed and ignored. Address canonical order is enforced by the controller, not by this schema.

provider_id.description: Must equal the Node's spec.providerID; 1-512 chars (infra-machine.md "InfraMachine: provider ID"). The controller normalizes "" to null before validation.

failure_domain.description: Actual placement; must equal the failure_domain input when that is non-null (enforced by the controller).

interruptible.description: true for spot/preemptible instances; null is written as false. Must be declared.
